summary: This study looks at how statin medications affect heart health and aging in older adults over a three-year period. Researchers are comparing participants taking a statin to those taking a placebo, which is an inactive substance that looks like the medicine. The study uses heart ultrasound tests called echocardiography, home heart rhythm monitoring, and lab tests to check heart function. Monash University is sponsoring this clinical trial, which currently has a status of Active, not recruiting and an enrollment of 369 participants.
